Title: Power BI Developer Center is live

Body.Content:
The Power BI Developer Center is now live. It's a one-stop shop for developers who want to customize or extend their Power BI solutions, create custom visuals, or embed Power BI in applications. You’ll find:

  • Easy access to our comprehensive set of APIs and SDK libraries.
  • Pointers for various developer scenarios, such as embedding visual analytics, creating custom visuals, and automating BI solutions.
  • Links to all the content and resources for developers, so you can find all the info you need to get your questions answered.
